The Makers Guild is the maker club of VIT Pune. We run a print lab with FDM and resin 3D printers, and we print your models for you.

Get a model printedMeet the printers

Our printers

Drag any printer to spin it around. Its specifications sit right underneath.

The Voron printers use the official open-source Voron 2.4 CAD model (frame and parts, without panels); the other printers are simplified illustrations. Specifications are typical values for each model; check with the club for the exact setup of our machines.

How to get your model printed

Click a step, or use the arrows, to follow the process from CAD file to finished print.
